protocol: Frozen final-role positive requests; retain all-OOV misses in denominators. All distinct known observed effective-view positives plus exactly 1000 uniformly sampled unique known-catalog distractors, excluding observed positives. Distractors have unobserved relevance, not verified negative feedback. Candidate scoring uses the frozen scalar feedback head, not the old generative head. Histories exclude the entire same-timestamp block. This diagnostic subset does not replace full-population feedback evaluation. No model/data/config changes or training.
